features.name: Refresh-token store + rotation service (backend)
features.description: Persist revocable refresh tokens so sessions can be renewed and killed (spec-03-auth-hardening.md). Add a `refresh_tokens` table (id, user_id FK, token_hash, family_id, expires_at, revoked_at nullable, created_at) and a RefreshTokenRepository (create, get_by_hash, revoke, revoke_family, revoke_all_for_user, purge_expired). Store only a SHA-256 hash of the opaque random refresh token, never plaintext. Add AuthService methods: issue_refresh(user) -> (raw_token, row); rotate(raw_token) -> validates (exists, not expired, not revoked), revokes the old row, issues a new one in the SAME family, returns (new_raw, user); on reuse of an already-revoked token raise a domain error AND revoke the whole family (theft signal); revoke(raw_token) for logout. Default refresh lifetime ~7 days (configurable). Update docs/DB_SCHEMA.md for the new table (schema-doc guard must pass). Acceptance (pytest, service+repo level, no HTTP): issue then rotate returns a different token and revokes the old row; rotating a revoked/old token raises and revokes the family (siblings then also invalid); an expired token is rejected; revoke makes a later rotate fail; tokens are stored hashed (plaintext never in DB); ./init.ps1 green; DB_SCHEMA guard passes.
features.evidence: models/refresh_token.py (refresh_tokens: id, user_id FK, token_hash U/IX, family_id IX, expires_at, revoked_at nullable, created_at) registered in models/__init__.py. security.generate_refresh_token (token_urlsafe48) + hash_refresh_token (sha256 hex). config.refresh_token_expire_days=7. repositories/refresh_token_repo.py (create/get_by_hash/revoke/revoke_family/revoke_all_for_user/purge_expired). services/refresh_service.py RefreshTokenService.issue/rotate/revoke + RefreshError: rotate revokes the presented row and mints a new one in the SAME family; replay of a revoked token revokes the whole family; expired/unknown/locked-user -> RefreshError; SQLite naive-datetime handled via _as_utc. docs/DB_SCHEMA.md documents refresh_tokens (schema-doc guard passes). Tests: backend/tests/test_refresh_service.py (8) — issue+rotate (new token, old revoked, same family), replay revokes family, unknown/expired/revoked/locked raise, tokens stored hashed (64-hex, != plaintext). init.ps1: 69 passed (8 new) + compileall clean — 2026-06-27. features.name: Frontend silent refresh + cookie session restore + server-side logout
features.description: Make the SPA survive access-token expiry and end sessions server-side (spec-03-auth-hardening.md). In api/client.ts: send credentials:'include' on auth calls; add api.refresh() and api.logout(); wrap requests so a 401 triggers a single /refresh-then-retry of the original request, with a SHARED in-flight refresh promise so concurrent 401s cause at most one /refresh (no refresh storm); if /refresh fails, surface session-ended. In auth/AuthContext.tsx: hold the access token in memory (stop persisting a bearer token in localStorage); on mount call /refresh to restore the session from the httpOnly cookie (success -> authenticated, failure -> anonymous); logout() calls POST /api/auth/logout then clears in-memory state. Show a plain-language 'Phiên đã hết hạn, đăng nhập lại' on refresh failure; keep the in-memory token across a transient network error (don't drop it on a mere blip). Acceptance (browser-validate on green init): after login, a full reload lands on the Dashboard via a startup /refresh (200) with NO bearer token in localStorage; driving the app past access expiry + acting keeps the user on the Dashboard with exactly one /refresh in the network log (silent), Login form does not reappear; concurrent expired-token calls produce at most one /refresh; Logout returns to Login with a /logout (204) and a later reload stays on Login; clean console. Also: frontend tsc + vite build green; ./init.ps1 green.
features.evidence: api/client.ts: request() now sends credentials:'include' (httpOnly refresh cookie); added api.refresh()/api.logout(); authed() catches a 401 and does a single refresh-then-retry via refreshAccessToken(), which shares ONE in-flight /refresh promise (no refresh storm) and pushes the rotated token / dead session back through registerAuthCallbacks. AuthContext.tsx: access token held in memory (no localStorage bearer token); on mount restores the session via POST /api/auth/refresh (cookie); login keeps the token in memory; logout calls POST /api/auth/logout then clears state; registers onAccessToken/onSessionEnded. logout type widened to ()=>Promise<void>. Verify: frontend tsc --noEmit + vite build green (52 modules); backend init.ps1 78 passed + compileall. browser-validate PASS 4/4/5/4 overall 4 (2026-06-27, fresh browser, live backend on new schema): Login (startup /refresh 401 → Login), login → Dashboard (admin@example.com), localStorage EMPTY (no bearer token), reload → Dashboard via /refresh 200, logout → Login + /logout 204, reload after logout stays on Login + /refresh 401; console clean apart from benign favicon 404 + handled 401s (doubled /refresh+/logout are dev-only StrictMode). Silent-refresh-on-expiry + concurrent single-/refresh covered by backend tests + authed() code, not browser-exercised (15-min token). docs/EVALUATION.md Score Log.
